name: postman-api-tests
description: Postman collection with automated API checks, run from the command line with Newman

scripts.test: newman run collections/jsonplaceholder.postman_collection.json -e environments/jsonplaceholder.postman_environment.json --folder Users --folder Posts --folder "Scenario - chained requests" -r cli,junit,htmlextra --reporter-junit-export reports/junit.xml --reporter-htmlextra-export reports/index.html --reporter-htmlextra-title "JSONPlaceholder API tests"
scripts.test:data: newman run collections/jsonplaceholder.postman_collection.json -e environments/jsonplaceholder.postman_environment.json --folder "Data-driven" -d data/posts.json -r cli,junit,htmlextra --reporter-junit-export reports/junit-data.xml --reporter-htmlextra-export reports/data-driven.html --reporter-htmlextra-title "JSONPlaceholder data-driven run"
